newsitem.title: USA: Zoltek two mln share offer at $32 a share.
newsitem.headline: Zoltek two mln share offer at $32 a share.

text.p: Zoltek Co Inc said Thursday it is offering to the public two million of its common shares at $32 each.
All of the shares are being sold by the company. Zoltek had registered the offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission in July.
An additional 300,000 shares may be sold by the company to an underwriting group, managed by Merrill Lynch & Co and Stifel, Nicolaus & Co, to cover over-allotments.
Net proceeds from the offering will be used for capital spending to expand the company's carbon fibers manufacturing capacity and for other corporate purposes.
Zoltek manufactures carbon fibers used as reinforcement material in composites.
